risks.risk: Camera may not be the claimed Nikon D810 (could be another Nikon DSLR body).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the camera model text/label (e.g., on the top/bottom plate) and the EXIF/“About” screen showing D810.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Nikon DSLR with an unknown lens condition (worst case vs D810).

risks.risk: Lens may not be the claimed 24-70mm (could be a different focal length or non-original/low-grade lens).
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the lens barrel markings showing the exact model (e.g., “AF-S 24-70mm …” or equivalent) and mount type.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown zoom lens (worst case: not confirmed 24-70mm).

risks.risk: Lens/camera may have functional issues (focus, zoom creep, autofocus motor, buttons, ports).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video: autofocus on a target at near and far distances + zoom in/out while recording; also show rear screen live view.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possible faults (worst case).

risks.risk: Sensor and optics may have dust, fungus, haze, or scratches not visible in this single angle photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the sensor at maximum aperture (f/16) showing dust, and close-ups of front and rear lens elements under light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as optics/sensor may need cleaning (worst case).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, caps, hood, strap) due to truncated “comes...” text.
risks.proof: Ask for a full accessories photo laid out (battery, charger, caps, hood, strap, manuals).
risks.if_unproven: Price as minimal/no accessories included (worst case).

proof_requests: Photo showing the exact camera model (D810) clearly (top/bottom label or “About” screen).
Close-up photo of the lens barrel markings showing the exact lens model and focal length (24-70mm) and mount.
Short video test: autofocus working + zoom in/out smoothly while showing live view on the screen.
Sensor test photo (dust check) and front/rear lens element close-ups under light.
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, caps/hood/strap).
response.reason: The photo confirms only a Nikon DSLR with a zoom lens, but the specific D810 model and the exact 24-70mm lens model are not readable. Without that, a worst-case price cannot be set confidently from the comparables.
